# Real-World Forecasting Case Studies

This section contains a collection of case studies illustrating failures, successes, and core principles in time series forecasting.

## Failures & Cautionary Tales
* **Zillow Offers:** The danger of ignoring regime changes.
* **Google Flu Trends:** The trap of overfitting and spurious correlations.
* **Parkfield Earthquake:** The risk of blind cycle extrapolation.
* **Long-Term Capital Management:** The "fat tail" risk in financial models.
* **IHME COVID Model:** The limitations of curve fitting vs. mechanistic models.

## Successes & Principles
* **Tesco Retail:** The value of adding exogenous variables.
* **Walmart M5:** The power of global models and cross-learning.

## Best Practices
* **Practitioner Tactics:** Essential tactics from *Foresight* journal.
* **Prophet Checklist:** How to use automated tools safely.
